import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from pydeseq2.dds import DeseqDataSet
from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats

counts = pd.read_csv('inputs/counts_raw_unfiltered.csv', index_col=0)
layout = pd.read_csv('inputs/sample_layout.csv')
sel_groups = ['DMSO','DMSO_Serum_starvation','Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50','Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50_Serum_starvation_16h']
sel = layout[layout.Group.isin(sel_groups)].copy()
# order as layout
cols = [s.replace('-','_') for s in sel.SampleID]
meta = sel.set_index('SampleID')[['Group']].rename_axis(index='sample')
meta.index = meta.index.str.replace('-','_')
# prefilter across all 30
keep = (counts > 10).any(axis=1)
sub = counts.loc[keep, cols]
print('sub', sub.shape, 'meta', meta)
# ensure order matching
sub = sub[meta.index]
print('group counts', meta.Group.value_counts())
dds = DeseqDataSet(counts=sub, metadata=meta, design_factors='Group', n_cpus=4)
print('dds created, obs', dds.n_obs, 'vars', dds.n_vars)
dds.deseq2()
print('deseq2 done')
ds = DeseqStats(dds, contrast=['Group','Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50','DMSO'], n_cpus=4)
ds.summary()
res = ds.results_df.copy()
print('res shape', res.shape)
print(res.head())
print('NA counts', res.isna().sum())
# filter criteria
sig = res[(res.padj <= 0.05) & (res.log2FoldChange.abs() >= 0.5) & (res.baseMean >= 10)].copy()
print('sig DEGs', sig.shape)
print(sig.head())
print('lfc range', sig.log2FoldChange.min(), sig.log2FoldChange.max())
print('baseMean min', sig.baseMean.min(), 'padj max', sig.padj.max())
# save interim to tmp for subsequent
res.to_csv('/workspace/tmp/pydeseq2_res.csv')
sig.to_csv('/workspace/tmp/sig_deg.csv')
print(sig.index[:10].tolist())
PY"

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from pydeseq2.dds import DeseqDataSet
from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats
import gseapy

# Inputs
counts_all = pd.read_csv('inputs/counts_raw_unfiltered.csv', index_col=0)
layout = pd.read_csv('inputs/sample_layout.csv')
mapping = pd.read_csv('inputs/ensg_to_gene_name.tsv', sep='\\t')
ensg_to_symbol = mapping.set_index('ENSG')['gene_name']

# Pre-filter across all 30 samples
keep_all = (counts_all > 10).any(axis=1)

# Keep only the four related groups for dispersion estimation and the requested contrast
groups = [
    'DMSO',
    'DMSO_Serum_starvation',
    'Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50',
    'Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50_Serum_starvation_16h',
]
meta = layout[layout['Group'].isin(groups)].copy()
meta['SampleID'] = meta['SampleID'].str.replace('-', '_', regex=False)
meta = meta.set_index('SampleID')[['Group']]
counts_sub = counts_all.loc[keep_all, meta.index]

# pydeseq2 expects samples x genes in this version
counts_model = counts_sub.T
dds = DeseqDataSet(
    counts=counts_model,
    metadata=meta,
    design='~Group',
    n_cpus=4,
    quiet=True,
)
dds.deseq2()
ds = DeseqStats(
    dds,
    contrast=['Group', 'Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50', 'DMSO'],
    alpha=0.05,
    n_cpus=4,
    quiet=True,
)
ds.summary()
res = ds.results_df

sig = res[
    (res['padj'] <= 0.05)
    & (res['log2FoldChange'].abs() >= 0.5)
    & (res['baseMean'] >= 10)
].copy()

# Map to the gene-symbol namespace required by Reactome_2022/Enrichr.
symbols = pd.Series(sig.index.map(ensg_to_symbol), index=sig.index)
symbols = symbols.dropna().astype(str)
symbols = symbols[symbols.str.len() > 0]
symbols = pd.Series(symbols.unique())

enr = gseapy.enrichr(
    gene_list=symbols.tolist(),
    gene_sets='Reactome_2022',
    organism='human',
    outdir=None,
    no_plot=True,
)
results = enr.results
term = 'TP53 Regulates Transcription Of Cell Cycle Genes R-HSA-6791312'
row = results.loc[results['Term'] == term].iloc[0]
odds_ratio = float(row['Odds Ratio'])

print('DEG_count', len(sig))
print('mapped_foreground_count', len(symbols))
print('term', row['Term'])
print('overlap', row['Overlap'])
print('odds_ratio_repr', repr(row['Odds Ratio']))
print('odds_ratio_float', odds_ratio)

with open('codex_output/answer.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f'{odds_ratio:.15g}\\n')
